description: This file defines a sealed internal class SiloMetadataClient implementing the ISiloMetadataClient interface in the Orleans.Runtime.MembershipService.SiloMetadata namespace. It contains a method to asynchronously retrieve silo metadata given a silo address, utilizing a grain factory to get a system target.

classes.name: SiloMetadataClient
classes.description: A class that provides methods to access silo metadata within the Orleans runtime, utilizing dependency injection of an internal grain factory.

methods.name: GetSiloMetadata
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves metadata for a specified silo address using the grain factory to obtain a system target and calling its GetSiloMetadata method.
